name: telegram-notifier
description: Send a text message to a single Telegram chat via the Bot API.
long_description: Minimal MCP server exposing one tool, `send_message(text, parse_mode?)`, that posts to https://api.telegram.org using the configured bot token and chat ID. Built for unattended notifications from scheduled tasks. Bot token is stored in OS-level secure storage (Windows Credential Manager on this machine).

chat_id.title: Chat ID
chat_id.description: Target chat ID to send messages to (integer as string, e.g. 889721252).
